Install over version 0.1.3 to keep your saved designs. When automatic floor tracking cannot start, View in room now opens Floor marker placement.

[Download the printable A4 marker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpsgroups/LBS-Mobile-App/v0.1.4/public/LBS-floor-marker.pdf). Print at 100%, measure the black square (180 mm), and lay it flat just in front of the furniture location. Point TOP toward the back of the design. Tap Start marker camera, then keep the whole marker in frame as you move. Scale is approximate and depends on print size and camera optics.
